title: Decoding Disease, Designing Interventions
summary: An introduction to research in the Jing Zhang Lab for the UC Irvine ICS Honors program. The talk covers MUSE, iMiracle, TargetSage, and CellReprogrammer, connecting tissue organization and cell-cell signaling with therapeutic target discovery and cell-state reprogramming.

title: From Immune Atlases to Therapeutic Reprogramming
summary: This talk connects single-cell immune atlas analysis with AI approaches to therapeutic target discovery and cell-state reprogramming. It covers NIK-related signaling across tissues and disease contexts, an interactive platform for donor-level atlas exploration, and KNOT for target identification. It also introduces TargetSage and CellReprogrammer and discusses potential extensions to cancer.
slides_note: Internal company talk; slides are not publicly available at this time.

title: AI-Driven Therapeutic Target Discovery and Cell-State Reprogramming
summary: This talk presents AI-based approaches to therapeutic target discovery and cell-state reprogramming.

title: scENCORE: Reconstructing Chromatin Compartments from Single-Cell Epigenetic Data
event: 13th Annual Symposium, Southern California Systems Biology
summary: This talk presents scENCORE, a computational method for reconstructing chromatin compartments from affordable, widely accessible single-cell epigenetic data.

title: iHerd: Identifying Key Driver Genes through Changes in Gene Networks
summary: This talk presents iHerd, a hierarchical graph representation learning framework for identifying key driver genes by comparing gene networks across biological conditions.
